items.text: Vision 7 admin must clearly guide program key test and release in order
items.acceptance: ordered three-step guide and next-action status are visible

items.text: No-program state must provide a first-program CTA and block invalid downstream work
items.acceptance: empty state opens program dialog and key/release controls cannot submit empty data

items.text: Program rows must issue a test key for the selected program without changing licensing APIs
items.acceptance: issue action preselects the exact program and preserves POST contract

items.text: Release form must stay collapsed until needed while preserving release history and upload behavior
items.acceptance: native details is closed by default and multipart release form remains intact

items.text: Key summary cards must filter the real visible key list with effective expiry
items.acceptance: five filter buttons combine with search and past expiry is treated expired

items.text: Vision 7 control must be compact accessible and touch safe on mobile
items.acceptance: responsive single-column layout labels focus styles and touch targets are at least 44px
